title: Executable HLS fMP4 Runtime Boundary
problem: Nako planning can now express HLS fMP4/adaptive intent, but the executable HLS runtime still assumes MPEG-TS segment layout, FFmpeg muxer args, request identity, artifact cleanup, and segment content type.

evidence.summary: Opened the executable HLS fMP4 runtime boundary lane for the first fMP4 single-variant runtime slice while splitting adaptive ladders into a follow-on.
Threaded HlsOutputRequirement into HLS transcode profile identity and server runtime layout selection; adaptive policy is explicit but non-executable in this slice.
Added fMP4 HLS request/muxer planning with .m4s segment patterns and init.mp4 muxer intent while preserving MPEG-TS defaults.
Updated HLS playlist rewrite, artifact content types, and stale cleanup for .ts, .m4s, and init .mp4 artifacts.
Closed the first slice after focused playback/transcode/server gates, cargo fmt check, and git diff check passed.

continue_policy.notes: Open a dedicated adaptive HLS ladder runtime lane before adding multi-variant master playlists, bitrate ladder planning, or per-variant segment directories.
